rationale: The Court will likely issue a relatively narrow AEDPA/party-presentation opinion reversing (or vacating and remanding) because the Fourth Circuit granted relief on an unexhausted, court-recast Remmer-like juror-bias theory rather than the exhausted Strickland claim under § 2254(d). Separate concurrences are most likely from Justices Thomas, Gorsuch, and Sotomayor to emphasize, respectively, AEDPA’s textual limits, party-presentation constraints, and fairness concerns while agreeing the Fourth Circuit exceeded its habeas authority.
